artifact_scope: G1 Gazebo V3.1 confirmatory execution validity study; retained failed confirmatory gate
retained_planning_result: Across all 90 attempted trials, the mandatory initial-plan audit remained consistent with the frozen planner mechanism: DynNavShortest and DynNavHistory selected the direct two-trigger route; DynNavRobustHistory selected the trigger-free detour.
exclusion_rule: No execution-efficacy or irreversible-failure conclusion may use V3.1 as confirmatory evidence because every dependence slice failed the preregistered minimum paired-valid History-vs-Robust threshold.
next_protocol_constraint: A new protocol may change localization infrastructure only if it preserves the exact frozen topology, trigger gates, blocker footprints, marginal probabilities, dependence conditions, planner objective, recoverability weight, and route-audit expectations.
